adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), the existing credential lookup is `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId: reqBody.userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } })`. If there are any pre-existing/legacy credentials for the same integration that don't have `appId` set to that exact slug (e.g., `appId` is `null` or stored differently), this lookup will miss them and the handler will `create` a new credential row instead of updating, potentially resulting in duplicates. The diff doesn't prove legacy data exists, but the handler as written has no fallback (e.g., by `type`) to avoid that scenario.
